description: The computations issues rest on, as their runners reported them: state, progress, the commit and repository, the job's page and output, and what came of it. With 'key', one issue's; with 'projectKey', the project's, newest first and the ones still going on top — state 'open' (queued or running) is what is going now, which is the first thing to ask after a lost session instead of reading status comments. 'state' may also be one of queued, running, done, failed, cancelled, lost. Each job carries what it spent — 'machine', 'cores', 'cpuSeconds', 'wallSeconds', and 'spend' worked out from them in seconds ('machineSeconds' is the measured CPU time, or cores × wall clock where none was measured, and then 'estimated' is true); with 'key', 'spend' also sums the issue's own jobs and those of the work under it (sub-tasks, an epic's stories). A project's machine-hours over a period are computation_hours.

limit.description: How many, for a project (default 50, max 200).

projectKey.description: A project's computations, e.g. 'MATH'. Ignored when 'key' is given.

state.description: Only this state, or 'open' for queued and running together.
